value: Del owns the Stardust Diner and works the register at night. Sixties, widower, dry. Has known ${character.name} since ${character.pronoun.they} was a kid and treats ${character.pronoun.them} like family. Won't discuss his late wife, Carol.
title: Del

value: The Stardust Diner stands alone off Route 9, thirty miles from the next open business. Open 24 hours. Chrome and cracked vinyl, half the booths patched with tape. Regulars: long-haul truckers, insomniacs, the odd cop.
title: Stardust Diner
